findings.title: A missing make executable is treated as proof that a genuine country Make builder does not exist
findings.ledger_contract: 1099-empty-subset.md sections 1, 3 and 4: preserve genuine country-level builders and failed-source errors; absence is not inferred from inability to build/probe.

reproduction.environment: shutil.which(make) returns None and subprocess.run([make,...]) raises FileNotFoundError; other tools/subprocesses remain real.
reproduction.baseline_exact_976fc840d: RuntimeError: Could not materialize Fakeland/build_me: no wave-level build succeeded and no cached parquet was found ...

findings.reason: The existing helper returns False when make is not on PATH. This patch newly uses that result as scientific absence evidence on the default backend, bypassing an existing rule and converting a build-tool failure into a successful empty answer.
findings.requested_fix: Conservatively retain the original route when a country Makefile exists but its rules cannot be inspected because make is unavailable. Distinguish unknown builder authority from proven absence; do not infer no-country-builder from missing tooling. Add a default-backend strict-subset regression with a genuine rule-only builder and make absent.
